hypothesis: Reproduce the purchased Hixton indicator as a causal closed-candle baseline on the existing ten-coin Binance Spot universe, without pair-specific tuning, then measure all ten independent 250-USDT diagnostics and the shared 250-USDT 3x80 portfolio.
development_window: rolling 3y ending at first clean execution
validation_window: same exact clean execution; diagnostics only
reason_accepted_or_rejected: MEASUREMENT BASELINE - NO PROMOTION DECISION BEFORE RESULTS
notes: Fresh isolated branch. No V12.33 entry/exit filters or pair-specific rules are allowed in this baseline. Pine ta.sma and ta.atr/RMA semantics are implemented explicitly.
change_summary: New independent Hixton family: VIDYA 10/20 smoothed by Pine-compatible SMA15, Pine-compatible ATR200 x2 bands, long on upper crossover, exit on lower crossunder; fixed 80-USDT stake; no pyramiding.
acceptance_criteria: Complete all ten 3y individual diagnostics with valid 1m/15m/1h/4h data audit and then complete the chronological shared 3x80 portfolio. Record results without post-result parameter changes.
lessons: Do not infer profitability before the clean run; any later variant must be materially different and receive a new fingerprint.
next_experiment: After baseline results, decide separately per coin whether Hixton is useful unchanged, as a filter, or should be rejected.

hypothesis: The original Hixton motor has positive raw trend capture on the first completed V1 diagnostics but loses too much to false breakouts, fees and late lower-band exits. A shared 1h VIDYA context guard plus an earlier 15m VIDYA midline exit should improve average edge per trade without pair-specific tuning.
validation_window: all ten individual diagnostics plus shared 3x80 portfolio
reason_accepted_or_rejected: REJECTED - shared portfolio lost about 68% and the midline exit destroyed large trend winners
notes: Complete V2 trade analysis found two separate issues: the 15m midline exit cut the few large winners that pay for a trend-following system, and the intended 1h VIDYA slope check was calculated after informative forward-fill by comparing adjacent 15m rows rather than native hourly values.
change_summary: Keep original 15m Hixton flip-up, require completed 1h close above a non-falling 1h Hixton VIDYA, exit on 15m close cross below Hixton VIDYA while green, retain original lower-band flip-down fallback; no pyramiding and no ROI target.
acceptance_criteria: Against V1, reduce fee drag and severe giveback while improving net P/L and profit factor across the ten-pair set; reject if gains are isolated to one or two coins or shared 250-USDT portfolio robustness worsens materially.
result_summary: 10 individual V2 diagnostics all negative; shared portfolio 250 -> about 79.99 USDT, 688 trades, PF 0.668. V1/V2 matched-entry analysis showed the guard-selected ETH and XRP trades would have been slightly positive with the original Hixton exit, while the V2 midline exit turned them materially negative.
lessons: Do not use an unconditional VIDYA-midline exit for this Hixton trend follower. Compute informative-timeframe slope before merging/forward-filling into 15m. Preserve large trend winners until evidence supports a profit-protection mechanism.

hypothesis: The V2 entry guard showed useful selection on matched V1 entries, but V2 was invalidated by a destructive midline exit and an incorrectly evaluated forward-filled 1h slope. Computing VIDYA slope inside the native 1h dataframe and restoring the original lower-band Hixton exit should preserve the guard's filtering benefit while allowing large trend winners to run.
validation_window: all ten individual diagnostics plus shared 3x80 portfolio
reason_accepted_or_rejected: RESEARCH CANDIDATE - MUST BE BACKTESTED BEFORE ACCEPTANCE
notes: V3A is deliberately narrow: no Hixton motor parameter changes, no coin-specific rules, no midline exit, no ROI target and no speculative trailing stop. It fixes only the two causes demonstrated by the V2 analysis.
change_summary: Keep purchased VIDYA10/momentum20/SMA15/ATR200x2 motor and 15m flip-up; calculate 1h hixton_vidya_rising on native 1h candles before informative merge; require completed 1h close above VIDYA plus native 1h non-falling VIDYA; exit only on original 15m lower-band flip-down.
acceptance_criteria: Must materially beat V2 on net P/L and PF without losing the large winners observed under the original Hixton exit. Evaluate all ten independent 3y diagnostics and the real shared 250-USDT max-3x80 portfolio before any further exit or parameter experiment.
lessons: V2 evidence supports correcting implementation and restoring original trend-following exit before any further optimization.
next_experiment: Run locked 3y ten-coin batch plus shared portfolio; then compare V3A against V2 and matched V1/V2 entries before designing any activated profit-protection experiment.
